title: London Family Adventure: Pixar, Harry Potter, Minecraft & Dinosaurs
summary: A 2-day family trip for two kids aged 7 and 11 who love Pixar movies, Harry Potter books, Minecraft and dinosaurs. The itinerary blends popular London highlights with taste-matched stops, ensuring prayer times are respected and halal food is available each day.

stops.why: The National Gallery displays masterworks of Western European painting, a popular landmark suitable for a family start.
stops.name: The National Gallery
stops.address: Trafalgar Square London WC2N 5DN United Kingdom
stops.description: Trafalgar Square museum displaying masterworks that trace the development of Western European painting.

stops.why: Wok and Fire is a verified halal Chinese restaurant, suitable for lunch.
stops.name: Wok and Fire

stops.name: Islamic Centre
stops.address: 10 Berwick St London W1F 0PH United Kingdom
stops.description: Central London mosque and cultural centre offering daily prayers and two Jumu'ah services; often male-only and with restricted opening outside adhan times.

stops.why: Natural History Museum showcases animatronic dinosaurs and skeletons, matching the kids' interest in dinosaurs.

stops.address: Cromwell Rd South Kensington, London SW7 5BD United Kingdom

tips: Use contactless payment for London transport; kids under 11 travel free on buses and trams.
Check prayer times daily and adjust if needed; mosques offer prayer facilities.
Pre-book tickets for popular attractions like Natural History Museum and SEA LIFE to save time.
